statements.impact_statement: Fixed in Keystone 2012.1. Keystone left date-based versions in 2015, so a scanner compares 30.x with 2012.1 and reports it; every Keystone built here has the fix.

Go's standard library in /usr/bin/pebble, which Ubuntu 26.04's container base image ships outside any package. Nothing in these images runs pebble: the base image's command is bash and each image runs its own service. Scoped to pebble; the same CVE in any other Go binary still fails the scan.
